# dist/

Build output. Generated by:

- `build/Build-Standalone.ps1` → `Foton-Collect_v{module}_schema{collect}.ps1` plus `Foton-Collect.ps1` (same bytes)
- `build/Build-BaselineStandalone.ps1` → `Foton-Baseline_v{module}_schema{baseline}.ps1` plus `Foton-Baseline.ps1` (same bytes)

Copy the **versioned** leaf to an endpoint so module and schema are visible in the filename. The unversioned names are a stable alias for docs and RMM. Do not deploy the module tree. Do not mix Collect and Baseline into the same script.

```powershell
.\build\Build-Standalone.ps1
.\build\Build-BaselineStandalone.ps1
# then on the target:
Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process Bypass -Force
.\Foton-Collect.ps1 -NoZip -OutputPath C:\FotonCases
.\Foton-Baseline.ps1 -NoZip -OutputPath C:\Baselines
```

Open `Foton_Report.html` (collect) or `Foton_Baseline.html` (baseline) from **inside** the new folder.

Do not hand-edit generated scripts. Change `src/` and rebuild.
